If you're looking for something just like GMod Tower, you might not like this game. Tower Unite retains the essence of the original mode, but changes so many things that it feels like a different game.

I can't exactly say that this is better than or the same as the original mode, because it isn't. It’s not very well optimized, the community isn’t exactly the best in the world (there are more people playing in the Casino than playing minigames), and most of the time there aren’t that many people playing. 

But the truth is that it’s a decent sequel and I see a lot of potential in the developers’ long-term ideas—it has the same game modes along with some new ones, more furniture, and more customization. Plus, the addition of the Workshop greatly expands the possibilities for maps, skins, etc. It’s worth buying with friends only when it’s on sale. It’s one of those underrated game modes that gave me many hours of gameplay in the original Garry’s Mod with my friends and has helped me meet some really cool people.

If you are worried you might get motion sick from this game, the third-person perspective mode is extremely broken. A lot of areas don't function in third person. For example, you can't bet on the horse races since it doesn't zoom in on the horse betting screen and for the shooting areas a lot of the time the camera is positioned directly behind your head and covers the crosshairs completely. It's kind of wild how bad it is and a lot is just not functional.

The overall concept is fantastic, but I wish there were more private areas (you can't gamble without people interacting with you) and the minigames you can play with friends (privately yay!!) are few and unbalanced. It relies really heavily on the steam workshop to have more interesting gameplay and customization options, which at this price tag is kind of disappointing to rely purely on its community to keep things fun. 

It took me too long to play it to refund so I'm sure I'll try again from time to time since I'm stuck with it, but it's overall really miserable and if you get motion sick, I highly recommend avoiding it entirely.

Because of this game, I enjoy mini golf and because I enjoy minigolf I am able to afford furniture for my condo in the game. The number of things that you can do in this game is endless. There's even a literal mall that you go to, and every store is enterable and allows you to buy furniture, clothes or even car dealerships for your new ride. You can even go to a liquor store and buy liquor, place it in your fridge and literally drink it and get drunk with friends in your condo. Every carnival food you buy, or soda can you purchase is consumable and placeable into your kitchen. There's nightclubs, movie theaters, mario kart knock off mini games and even water slides. This game exceeded my expectations. Buy. The. Game.
